work.title: Reduce WorktreeManager to checkout lifecycle
work.description: Restrict worktree behavior to attach, find, remove, prune, validate checkout ownership, and inspect cleanliness of a live checkout. It must not create base commits, advance the base, write manifests, or decide lifecycle transitions.
acceptance: WorktreeManager does not move any repository ref except through explicit branch checkout operations
Recreating a missing worktree is safe
An occupied or unrecognized directory is refused
Base checkout dirtiness can be inspected through an explicit operation
